{{Short description|37th season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 1967-68 National Hurling League |image = |dates = 8 October 1967 – 1 October 1968 |teams = |team1 = Tipperary |captain1 = |manager1 = |titles = 13th |team2 = |captain2 = |manager2 = |two=Kerry |three = Louth |previous = [[1966–67 National Hurling League|1966–67]] |next = [[1968–69 National Hurling League|1968–69]] }} The '''1967–68 National Hurling League''' was the 37th season of the [[National Hurling League]]. ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |season=1967-68 |winners=[[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]]

On 16 June 1968, [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] won the title following a 6–27 to 4–22 aggregate win over [[New York GAA|New York]] in the finals. It was their first league title since [[1964-65 National Hurling League|1964-65]] and their 12th National League title overall.{{cite web|url=https://www.irishexaminer.com/sport/gaa/kilkenny-v-tipperary-1968-the-only-day-in-my-career-i-felt-a-bit-afraid-on-the-field-469526.html|title = Kilkenny v Tipperary 1968: 'The only day in my career I felt a bit afraid on the field'|date=16 April 2018|work=Irish Examiner|accessdate=19 April 2018}} Tipperary's [[Jimmy Doyle (hurler)|Jimmy Doyle]] was the Division 1 top scorer with 4-50. ===Division 1A table=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: centre;" !width=20|Pos !width=150|Team !width=20|Pld !width=20|W !width=20|D !width=20|L !width=20|Diff !width=20|Pts !width=250|Notes |- |'''1'''||align=left|''' [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] '''||'''5'''||'''4'''||'''1'''||'''0'''||'''36'''||'''9''' |- style="background:gold;" |'''2'''||align=left|''' [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] '''||'''5'''||'''3'''||'''1'''||'''1'''||'''26'''||'''7'''|| Division 1 champions |- |'''3'''||align=left|''' [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] '''||'''5'''||'''3'''||'''1'''||'''1'''||'''16'''||'''7''' |- |'''4'''||align=left|''' [[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] '''||'''5'''||'''2'''||'''0'''||'''3'''||'''-12'''||'''4''' |- |'''5'''||align=left|''' [[Offaly GAA|Offaly]] '''||'''5'''||'''1'''||'''1'''||'''3'''||'''-8'''||'''3''' |- |'''6'''||align=left|''' [[Laois GAA|Laois]] '''||'''5'''||'''0'''||'''0'''||'''5'''||'''-58'''||'''0''' |} ===Group stage=== {{football box collapsible |date = 8 October 1967 |time = |round = |team1 = [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] |score = 4-10 -
